thread:
ada: Quick RFC follow-up: propose splitting connector onboarding into two tiny phases: hello (fast attestation + egress hint) and attach (steady dataplane). Low-risk for Private customers.

ravi: Sounds good. Hello should be idempotent and cheap. What fields do we need?

ada: Minimum: tenant_id, proof_sig (KMS or CP short token), egress_ip_hint, mode. No long-lived connections yet.

mira: For attach: session_token issued referencing hello thumbprint, kv-sync opt-in, metrics stream. Token TTL must be revocable.

ravi: How do we handle legacy connectors? Add a feature header like `X-Connector-Features: hello,attach-v1` so CP can respond appropriately.

ada: Rollout plan: support hello endpoint in CP, release connector v2 with attach opt-in, canary attach to 4 tenants, flip per-tenant flag. Fallback: remain in hello-only and proxy via regional relay.

deploy-bot: :gear: started canary deploy connector-onboard/v2 -> infra-canary-7 (logs: https://deploys.internal/3932101111)

mira: Alerts to add: hello_fail_rate, attach_latency_p95, attach_revoked_count. Trigger if hello_fail_rate > 0.5% in canary.

ravi: Add clear error codes `ONB_401_EXPIRED`, `ONB_409_UNSUPPORTED`. Makes troubleshooting easier.

ada: I'll draft the small protocol appendix and runbook. Can @ravi and @mira review by EOD?

mira: Yes.
